content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NGRI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CSIR NGRI recruitment is 13 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Assistant-II / Project Associate-I / II in the CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant-II (PA-II) post, candidates need to have a B. Sc degree with Computer Science as their educational qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the CSIR NGRI posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-I (PAT-I) posts ranges from Rs. 25000/- to Rs. 31000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection methods for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026 includes a Walk-in Interview and an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the positions advertised by CSIR NGRI?
faq.answer: The positions advertised by CSIR NGRI under this recruitment are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of CSIR NGRI?
faq.answer: CSIR National Geophysical Research Institute (CSIR NGRI) is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500007.
